description: One CVM account across fiscal years for a Brazilian listed company -- e.g. account_code "3.01" for the income-statement top line, "1" for total assets, "2.03" for equity -- in full BRL with the account label, scope and filing version of each year. Pass cnpj or name. Account codes follow the CVM chart (1 assets, 2 liabilities and equity, 3 income statement, 6 cash flow, 7 value added); labels and meaning differ between banks/insurers and industrials, and the label is returned per year so a change is visible. Years the company did not file the account are listed in missing_years rather than dropped. A code the company never reported returns found:false with data_as_of.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ, formatted or 14 digits. Pass cnpj or name.

from_year.description: First fiscal year (default: the earliest this company filed).

scope.description: Default: consolidated where filed, else individual (each row says which).

to_year.description: Last fiscal year (default: the latest this company filed).
